---
title: "EarningsStability_Confed_Race"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# JQI: Earnings Stability, Confidence in Government,
#      Race, and Temporal Heterogeneity
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)
library(car)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load and prepare data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jqi_gss <- readRDS(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "gss_job_quality_primary_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)


jqi_confed_race <- jqi_gss %>%
  mutate(

    # Confidence in government
    #
    # 1 = Great deal
    # 2 = Only some
    # 3 = Very little
    #
    # Higher = less confidence

    confidence_government = case_when(
      as.numeric(confed) %in% 1:3 ~
        as.numeric(confed),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Race
    race_group = case_when(
      racecen1 == 1 ~ "White",
      racecen1 == 2 ~ "Black",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    race_group = factor(
      race_group,
      levels = c("White", "Black")
    )

  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(confidence_government),
    !is.na(race_group),
    !is.na(compensation),
    !is.na(benefits),
    !is.na(earnings_stability)
  )


# ============================================================
# 2. Year-specific race × earnings-stability models
# ============================================================

yearly_confed_race <- jqi_confed_race %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  group_modify(~ {

    model <- lm(
      confidence_government ~
        compensation * race_group +
        benefits * race_group +
        earnings_stability * race_group,
      data = .x
    )

    tidy(model) %>%
      filter(
        term %in% c(
          "race_groupBlack",
          "compensation:race_groupBlack",
          "race_groupBlack:benefits",
          "race_groupBlack:earnings_stability"
        )
      )

  }) %>%
  ungroup()

yearly_confed_race


# ============================================================
# 3. Full model with race × earnings stability × year
# ============================================================

m_confed_time_full <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    compensation * race_group * factor(year) +
    benefits * race_group * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * race_group * factor(year),
  data = jqi_confed_race
)

summary(m_confed_time_full)


# ============================================================
# 4. Restricted model
#
# Race differences in slopes are constant across time.
# ============================================================

m_confed_time_restricted <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    compensation * race_group +
    benefits * race_group +
    earnings_stability * race_group +

    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year) +

    race_group * factor(year),

  data = jqi_confed_race
)


# ============================================================
# 5. Formal test of temporal heterogeneity
# ============================================================

anova(
  m_confed_time_restricted,
  m_confed_time_full
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Specifically test whether the
#    earnings-stability racial difference varies by year
# ============================================================

earnings_three_way_terms <- grep(
  "^earnings_stability:race_groupBlack:factor\\(year\\)",
  names(coef(m_confed_time_full)),
  value = TRUE
)

linearHypothesis(
  m_confed_time_full,
  earnings_three_way_terms
)


# ============================================================
# 7. Plot-ready table of earnings-stability interactions
# ============================================================

earnings_year_results <- yearly_confed_race %>%
  filter(
    term == "race_groupBlack:earnings_stability"
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value
  )

earnings_year_results


# ============================================================
# 8. Save results
# ============================================================

write_csv(
  yearly_confed_race,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_ConfidenceGovernment_Race_YearSpecific.csv"
  )
)

write_csv(
  earnings_year_results,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_ConfidenceGovernment_EarningsStability_Race_Year.csv"
  )
)
```
